page.running_head: ARNOLDI GEULINX, descimus ad convitium usque & verbera

main_text.head: Quæstio XVI.
An officii gratia, invisentem amicum, geniali potione accipere conveniat.
main_text.p: TArdum ac austerum, etiam inter familiarissimos sermonis initium: Nam is depulso necdum lentore, quem à præcedente silentio trahit, laborat in vestibulo, & duriusculè, quasi remorantes inter asperitates, provolvitur: Si proinde limen istud geniali liquore proluimus, salva res est: lubricâ jam semitâ, fertur ocyùs in consuetas fabulas, quæ horas devorant & diem: & ne sic quidem expletæ, ad seram noctem abrumpuntur veriùs,

page.notes: The initial "T" is a large woodcut initial joined to "Ardum". The word "Tardum" is printed as "Ardum" after the initial; the opening word is read as TArdum with the initial letter T. Show-through text from the facing page is ignored.
